verdict.rationale: Cline is operated through natural language by design. The docs say it builds features "through natural conversation", and CLI examples take plain-English prompts such as "run tests and fix failures". Chat is also available from Slack, Discord, Telegram and Linear, and community users describe planning with it conversationally and then letting it execute. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evaluation of how reliably and accurately its natural-language commands are carried out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It can read and write files, run terminal commands, use a browser, and help you build features through natural conversation.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Chat with the agent from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear.
I can plan with it for 10-15 minutes, set it loose on my codebase, go get lunch, and then its diff is almost always completely on the money.
